# Arsenal Pro API

Small Node/Express + Postgres API for the Arsenal Pro bowling app
(https://majalen3.github.io/arsenal-pro-bowling/).

**Data scope:** accounts are optional. Without one, every request must send `X-Device-Id` (8-64 chars `A-Za-z0-9_-`, generated by the app and kept in localStorage); all rows are scoped to that id, so one device cannot read, overwrite or delete another's data. The id is a capability, not authentication: anyone who knows it can access that data. Limits: 120 req/min and 40 writes/min per device, 600 req/min per IP (429 + Retry-After); 300 lines, 500 surface entries, 200 pattern notes per device. Free-tier notes: the web service sleeps when idle (first call ~30 s) and the free Postgres expires ~30 days after creation.

## Run
`DATABASE_URL=postgres://... npm install && npm start` (tables are created on startup; DB connection is retried).

## Optional accounts (`/api/auth/*`, `/api/account*`)

Email + password, so a bowler's own balls, layouts, bags, profile, games and shots follow them to any phone. The app works fully
without an account. Design (see the app's DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-31):
- Passwords and recovery keys hashed with Node's built-in `crypto.scrypt` (N=16384, r=8, p=1, random 16-byte salt). Min 8 chars.
- Sessions: random 32-byte bearer token in `Authorization: Bearer …` (not a cookie: the app and the API are different sites).
  The DB stores only `HMAC-SHA256(token, SESSION_PEPPER)`. 30-day expiry (`SESSION_DAYS`); logout revokes.
- `SESSION_PEPPER` (32+ chars) comes from a Render env var (`generateValue` in render.yaml); without it these routes answer 503.
- An account's events are stored in `events` under `device_id = 'u:<user id>'`. A device code cannot contain `:`, so
  the device routes can never read or write an account stream. Every account query is scoped by the session's user id.
- CORS: only the origins in `CORS_ORIGINS` (default `https://majalen3.github.io`); other origins get 403. Device routes keep `*`.
- Rate limits: sign-up 5/hour/IP; login and recovery 20/15 min/IP and 8/15 min/email (429 + Retry-After); per account 120 req/min, 40 writes/min.
- No email sender is configured, so password reset uses the one-time **recovery key** shown at sign-up (using it rotates the key
  and signs out every device). Email reset needs an email provider API key (e.g. a transactional email service) set as an env var.
- Account quota `ACCOUNT_EVENT_QUOTA` (default 20000 events).

Routes: `POST /api/auth/signup {email,password}` → `201 {token, expiresAt, user, recoveryKey}` (409 if the email exists) ·
`POST /api/auth/login {email,password}` → `{token, expiresAt, user}` (generic 401) · `POST /api/auth/recover {email,recoveryKey,newPassword}` ·
`POST /api/auth/logout [{all:true}]` · `GET /api/account` → `{user, stored, quota}` · `GET|POST /api/account/events` (same contract as
`/api/events`) · `GET /api/account/export` → `{user, events}` · `DELETE /api/account {password}` → removes the user, sessions and events.

## My Team (`/api/account/teams/*`, needs an account)

A small team hub for league nights (app: `#/team`, under Bag). Additive tables only (`teams`, `team_members`, `team_invites`,
`team_shares`, `team_notes`, `team_reports`; all `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, in `lib/teams.js`). Rules:
- Every route is behind the account session and the account CORS allowlist. A non-member gets **404** for any team route (existence
  is not leaked); secretary-only actions answer 403 to members. Teammates see display names and per-team member ids, never emails or account ids.
- Invite codes: 8 characters `XXXX-XXXX` (no 0/O/1/I), shown once, stored as `HMAC-SHA256('invite:'+code, SESSION_PEPPER)`;
  expire in 1–14 days (default 7), optional use cap, revocable. Expired/revoked/used-up/unknown → 410.
- Sharing is per item (`bag`, `stats`, `tags`, `regular`), strict shapes, unknown fields dropped, 2000 bytes each. No ranking fields exist.
- Caps: 10 teams per account, 40 members, 300 notes, 10 open invites, 100 open reports. Rate limits: create 5/day, join 10/15 min
  per account and 30/15 min per IP, invites 20/h, notes 30/h, reports 10/h (env `RL_TEAM_*` override for tests).
- Removing or leaving deletes that member's shares, notes and reports; the last member leaving deletes the team; if the secretary
  leaves, the earliest-joined member becomes secretary. No profanity filter: the secretary handles reports and can remove notes/members.
- `GET /api/account/export` includes `teams` (my memberships, my shares, my notes); `DELETE /api/account` removes them too.

Routes: `GET|POST /` · `POST /join {code,displayName}` · `GET /:tid` · `POST /:tid/settings` (sec) · `POST /:tid/me` ·
`GET|POST /:tid/invites`, `DELETE /:tid/invites/:iid` (sec) · `POST|DELETE /:tid/shares/:kind` · `POST /:tid/notes`, `DELETE /:tid/notes/:nid` ·
`POST /:tid/reports`, `DELETE /:tid/reports/:rid` (sec) · `DELETE /:tid/members/:mid` (`me` = leave) · `DELETE /:tid` (sec).

## Endpoints (JSON, CORS `*` incl. `X-Device-Id`, 20kb body limit, security headers)
- `GET /api/health`
- `POST /api/lines` `{ballId,name,release,aim,speed,rev,oil?,finish,pattern,note}` — upsert by ballId+name
- `GET /api/lines?ballId=...`
- `DELETE /api/lines/:id`
- `POST /api/surface-log` `{ballId,date:"YYYY-MM-DD",finish}`
- `GET /api/surface-log?ballId=...`
- `POST /api/pattern-notes` `{lane,oil,adjustment}`
- `GET /api/pattern-notes[?limit=1-200&before=<id>]`: newest first, 50 by default; `X-Next-Before` header when there are more
- `POST /api/events` `{events:[envelope…]}` (v2 sync, ≤ 500 events and 20 kB per batch). Idempotent per (device, event id); returns `{accepted, duplicates, cursor, stored, quota}`. Per-device quota `EVENT_QUOTA` (default 5000) → `429 {error, quota, stored}` without Retry-After
- `GET /api/events?after=<cursor>&limit=1-500` → `{events, cursor, more}` in server order
- `GET /api/me`: exports lines, surface log, pattern notes **and events** for this device
- `DELETE /api/me`: wipes all rows for this device, including events

### Ball spec lookup (no device id needed; 30 lookups / 10 min / IP)

`GET /api/spec-lookup?brand=Radical&name=Rattler%20Big%20Bite` or `?url=<maker product page>`. The API fetches **only** the
manufacturer hosts in `lib/specfetch.js` (Storm site incl. Roto Grip/900 Global, Brunswick, Radical, DV8, Hammer, Ebonite, Track,
Columbia 300), https only, every redirect re-checked, public IPs only, 1.5 MB / 8 s caps, robots.txt + Crawl-delay honoured, UA
`ArsenalProSpecLookup/1.0`. Motiv is `unsupported` (their site answers 403). `lib/specparse.js` returns only labelled values printed
on the page (`{v, raw, label}`, `derived:true` when cover type/symmetry come from the printed cover/core name) and per-weight
RG/Diff tables. Response `status`: `found` (with `source.url`, `source.fetchedAt`), `candidates` (pick one, then call with `?url=`),
`not-found`, `unsupported`, `blocked`, `busy`; 400 on bad input or an off-list URL. Results are cached in `spec_cache` (30 days found,
1 day otherwise). **`spec_cache` is global public maker data with no device id**, so `/api/me` has nothing of the user's in it.

## Tests
`BASE=http://localhost:8787 npm test` (node:test; needs a running server + Postgres started with `SESSION_PEPPER=<32+ chars> RL_SIGNUP=1000 EVENT_QUOTA=50 RL_TEAM_CREATE=1000 RL_TEAM_JOIN=1000 RL_TEAM_JOIN_IP=1000`; optional `TEST_DATABASE_URL` (a local DB only) lets the invite-expiry check move an expiry into the past; refuses to run against onrender.com; cleans up its own device ids and accounts).
